request.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE definitive full-body STANCE master sprite of Higgs from DEATH STRANDING 1 / Director's Cut for this painted 2D fan game. The TWO provided images have distinct roles. IMAGE 1 is a canonical in-game close-up: it is the authority for the GOLDEN SKULL MASK, hood opening, dark eye area and gold anatomical details. IMAGE 2 is the existing whole-body game sprite: preserve its adult male proportions, overall costume silhouette, ochre-yellow suit, black hooded cloak with blue-and-gold edge bands, gloves, straps, pouches, chest pod, knee pads and heavy black boots. Correct the head decisively using IMAGE 1. The new mask must be the recognizable sculpted GOLD HUMAN SKULL LOWER FACE: distinct bony cheekbones, a hollow black nasal opening, projecting upper jaw, individually separated metallic teeth and lower jaw, worn over a black close-fitting under-mask. The eyes remain visible as separate dark eye openings under the hood; the center between them is anatomical gold skull structure. Do not copy image 2's smooth gold faceplate or continuous black horizontal visor. No sunglasses, goggles, horizontal glass strip, polished featureless face shield, robotic helmet, ordinary cloth mask or DS2 red hair. Retain the dark hood around the face, with the skull mask projecting naturally rather than a tiny painted icon. Preserve the established costume design from image 2 and its painted shading, precise dark contours, cloth folds and readable metal edges. High detail, restrained wet highlights, charcoal shadows and aged gold; consistent painted game illustration rather than a photograph. Pose: quiet alert standing stance facing RIGHT in side three-quarter view, both feet planted on the same invisible baseline, slightly bent knees, one gloved hand near the upper chest and the other relaxed near the belt. Keep the face turned enough toward the viewer that the sculpted nose, cheekbones and teeth are clear while the character still reads as right-facing. FULL BODY, complete hood, cloak hem, both arms, all hands and both boots. Portrait canvas with the figure about 84 percent of the height and clear alpha margin on all sides, including the flowing cloak on the left. Exactly one character and one pose. True transparent alpha-zero background, no ground plane, contact shadow, backdrop, scenery, smoke, particles, weapon effects, detached objects, text, HUD, watermark or pose sheet. This is the identity master for all subsequent poses: prioritize stable skull-mask anatomy, costume construction and adult body proportions.
